name: Founding Cohort 01

projects.name: Audit
projects.brief: Identify one recurring problem and the people it affects.
criteria: Name the person and recurring problem

projects.name: Design
projects.brief: Map the user's journey and the result they need.
criteria: Connect the problem to a useful result
Map the steps from first contact to result
Mark human review and AI assistance

projects.name: Prototype
projects.brief: Build a small version of your proposed workflow.

projects.name: Test
projects.brief: Check whether the prototype helps with the chosen problem.

projects.name: Ship
projects.brief: Put a bounded, useful version into real use.

projects.name: Measure
projects.brief: Compare a tracked result with your starting point.

credentials: Six accepted projects, four live/replay takeaways, showcase and evidence; human issuance remains unimplemented. Community contributions are separate.
credential_requirements: All six projects accepted, with peer feedback first and a human facilitator decision
All four Sunday group sessions attended live, or reviewed replay with a posted takeaway
Evidence saved: submissions, feedback and acceptance dates, Ship real-use proof, Measure tracked result, attendance and showcase
